subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_diode_bias_generator ib_sink vdd
M6 ib_sink ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_diode_bias_generator
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M6 to establish the PMOS bias voltage ib_sink for the OTA core current-source device.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt self_biased_complementary_ota_core gnd ib_sink vdd vin vip vo
M2 net1 net2 gnd gnd nch l=ln_tail w=wn_tail m=1 nf=1
M1 vo vin net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M0 net2 vip net1 gnd nch l=ln_input w=wn_input m=1 nf=1
M5 net3 ib_sink vdd vdd pch l=lp_tail w=wp_tail m=1 nf=1
M4 vo vin net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
M3 net2 vip net3 vdd pch l=lp_input w=wp_input m=1 nf=1
.ends self_biased_complementary_ota_core
subcircuits.role_hint: Main single-ended complementary OTA core. NMOS and PMOS differential input devices process vin and vip, with vo as the single-ended output. M5 receives the external PMOS bias ib_sink, while M2 is an internal self-biased NMOS tail/control device driven by net2.
